title: One-year outcomes and safety assessment of faricimab in treatment-naïve patients with neovascular age-related macular degeneration in Japan

groups.description: Type 1 and/or type 2 macular neovascularisation (baseline subtype, Table 2 column C3)
Polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy (namd subtype, Table 2 column C4)
Type 3 macular neovascularisation (namd subtype, Table 2 column C5)

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA rows R5-R8, all columns (Total and the type 1/2 MNV, PCV and type 3 MNV subgroups)
exclusions.reason: The analysis set is 57 of the 70 treatment-naive eyes that received faricimab: patients who switched to aflibercept, did not return, died or developed iritis were removed from every visit, baseline included (Methods, Participants). Post-baseline-events ruling, and a complete-case set of a larger treated cohort: no record.

exclusions.what: Table 2 row R6, BCVA at 1 year (final visit within the 12-15-month period)
exclusions.reason: Time range, not a dated visit.
Model estimates; supplementary files are not acquired.

notes: Loading with three monthly faricimab injections (a fourth when fluid persisted), then treat-and-extend with 8-16-week intervals.
Within the 57-eye set, missing monthly values were carried forward (LOCF) (Methods).
BCVA measured with an ETDRS chart (one centre) or a Landolt C chart (four centres) and converted to logMAR for the outcome analyses.
The subtypes (type 1/2 MNV, PCV, type 3 MNV) are all namd.
